sections.heading: pou-le-cei\e\3pur-pos
paragraphs: \e-各\e\3人\sou\3自\e\3人生\e\3道\e\3決\kou自\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\e\3展\kou自\e\3志\e\3追\kou-sou-shal\e\3參\ha無正當理由\e\3干涉無\kou-dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon無\kou壓迫無\e\3rait\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

sen-zou-vi-a\e\3ga-van-man\e\3pur-pos\wou\3人\e\3控\kou生活\ha可接受\e\3定\kou-sou-shal\e\3一致\e\3強迫\pou\2\chi\4\wu\2\le\4。sen-zou-vi-a\e\3ga-van-man\e\3pur-pos\wou\3rait\ha基\e\3護\kou公正\e\3維\kou-o-por-tiu-ni-ti\ha-i-kual\e\3供\kou民\ha-pou-wer\e\3源\e\3奉\pou\2\chi\4。
fu-ri-dom\wou\3sen-zou-vi-a\e\3ga-van-man\e\3干涉\e\3免及他人或他in-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3kou-er-shon\kou-dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\kou-eks-pu-loi-tei-shon\kou-pou-wer\ha任意\e\3侵害\e\3護\pou\2\chi\4。

ri-pab-lik\wou\3\e人\wou\3o-por-tiu-ni-ti\ha自\bou\3\e\a控\e\3處境\e\3因\ou失\hou\2則fu-ri-dom\ha實無\e\3命題\ou認。\e-o-por-tiu-ni-ti\ha-i-kual\wou\3国\e\3fu-ri-dom\e\3解\e\3部\ha不可分\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 1. fu-ri-dom\ha人\kou基\e\3護
paragraphs: \e-国\wou\3此\e\3fu-ri-dom\e\3行\ou任意干涉\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。国\wou\3此\e\3fu-ri-dom\e\3制限\ha-lou\kou-kon-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3明確授權\kou他人\e\3rait\ha基\e\3護\ha-pur-pos\kou-ju-di-shal\e\3監\ha-in-di-pen-den-te\e\3條件下\ou\e\a行\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 2. jen-der\e\3i-kual：kon-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3pu-rin-si-pol\ha基
paragraphs: \e-人\wou\3特定\e\3jen-der\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\tou\ou何人\bi\ou生理特征或sou-shal\e\3期待或家\e\3傳統或ri-li-jon\e\3dok-chin\te強迫接\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 3. jen-der\e\3dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\kou從屬\e\3除
paragraphs: \e-ri-pab-lik\wou\3直接\e\3jen-der\e\3騷擾\kou-jen-der\e\3不平等\e\3公開宣揚\kou他人\e\3jen-der\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\e\3故意否定\e\3pe-nal-ti\ha可行\ou行\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-此\e\3pe-nal-ti\wou\3被害人\ha特定\e\3未明\kou身\e\3傷\e\3未證\te亦適用\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-ri-ser-chi\ha-a-ka-de-mik\kou善意\ha論理\kou-e-vi-dens\e\3基\wou\3\bi\ou護\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 6. di-ji-tal\e\3pu-rai-va-si\e\3護\ha全\e\3建
paragraphs: \e-調查\e\3ak-se-si-bi-li-ti\ha例外\wou\3li-gol\kou具體\kou-in-di-pen-den-te\e\3監受\e\3根據\ha正當\ou要\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 7. 全\e\3人\e\3o-por-tiu-ni-ti\ha-i-kual\e\3護
paragraphs: \e-人\wou\3何人或em-pu-loi-man\kou-pab-lik\e\3服務\kou個人\e\3展\e\3o-por-tiu-ni-ti\ou機會無關\e\3人\e\3特征\te拒\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 8. ak-se-si-bi-li-ti\kou包容\e\3確保
paragraphs: \e-ri-pab-lik\wou\3\e-i-kual\e\3待遇\wou\3身\kou感官\kou認知\kou他ak-se-si-bi-li-ti\e\3需\ha異\e\3人\e\3便利\ha當\ou要\hou\2\ou認\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 10. lou前\e\3人\e\3i-kual\e\3護
paragraphs: \e-人\wou\3免責\kou-lou\e\3待遇\ha特權\ou富或sou-shal\e\3地位或pou-li-ti-kol\e\3im-pak-te或in-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3pou-wer或私交\te得\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 12. rait\ha人\e\3護：国\e\3責\ha永久
paragraphs: \e-国\e\3rait\ha人\e\3in-si-ti-tiu-shon\ha-in-di-pen-den-te\wou\3kon-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3保障\e\3落實\e\3監\kou侵權\e\3調\kou弱勢人\e\3護\kou-re-me-di\ha便捷\e\3供\ou行\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

sections.heading: pou-le-cei\e\3内容

subsections.heading: 1. 人\e\3rait\e\3kon-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3最高位
paragraphs: \e-kon-si-ti-tiu-shon\wou\3lou\ha普通\kou行政指令\kou-in-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3規\kou文化傳統\kou-ri-li-jon\e\3dok-chin\e\3先\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-他人\e\3rait\e\3侵害\e\3防\hou必需\e\3干預\wou\3lou\e\3明基\kou护\e\3正當\e\3pur-pos\kou-ju-di-shal\e\3ri-viu\ha-in-di-pen-den-te\ou要\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-国\wou\3\e-fu-ri-dom\ha人\wou\3ga-ver-nans\kou-pab-lik\e\3起点\ou系\sou\3\hou\2\kou\e制限\wou\3lou\e\3具體理由\ou要\hou\2\ou認\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 2. 表達\kou思想\kou-pou-li-ti-kol\e\3參\e\3fu-ri-dom
paragraphs: \e-sen-zou-vi-a\e\3ga-van-man\e\3批評\ha嚴\kou諷刺\kou不滿\e\3公開表達\wou\3pe-nal-ti\ha-ku-raim\e\3理由\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-人\sou\3示威\ha和平\e\3參\kou社團\e\3建\kou-pou-li-ti-kol\e\3or-ga-nai-zei-shon\e\3入\kou-pab-lik\e\3議\e\3參\e\3fu-ri-dom\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-国\wou\3pou-li-ti-kol\e\3忠誠\ou-pab-lik\e\3服務\ha普通\kou-yu-du-kei-shon\kou-em-pu-loi-man\kou-lou\e\3護\ha基\e\3條件\te用\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-ri-pab-lik\wou\3思想\e\3fu-ri-dom\ha人\kou基\ou認\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。pu-rai-vet\e\3信念\ha-sou-shal\e\3主流\e\3值反\ha僅持\wou\3ku-raim\pou\2\chi\4\wu\2\le\4。

subsections.heading: 3. jen-der\e\3i-kual\kou-jen-der\e\3au-to-no-mi\e\3決\e\3fu-ri-dom
paragraphs: \e-lou\wou\3jen-der\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\ou生殖器\e\3構造或染色體或出生指定\e\3jen-der或男性\kou女性氣質\e\3傳統期待\ha僅\te決\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-人\sou\3外貌\kou服\kou髮\kou表達\kou-ai-den-ti-ti\e\3決\e\3fu-ri-dom\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-人\wou\3他人或傳統\e\3jen-der\e\3角色\e\3符\ou強迫\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

\e-家\e\3人\kou-yu-du-kei-shon\e\3in-si-ti-tiu-shon\kou-em-pu-loi-er\kou-ri-li-jon\e\3or-ga-nai-zei-shon\kou他權威\e\3jen-der\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\e\3強加\ha-kou-er-shon\kou恐嚇\kou-vai-o-lens\kou制限\ha-i-li-gol\te-\wou\3\bi\ou禁\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

\e-jen-der\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\kou-jen-der\e\3eks-pu-re-shon\e\3rait\wou\3人\ha未成年\te\hou伸\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-此\e\3rait\wou\3發展中\e\3a-bi-li-ti\kou-wel-feir\ha人\e\3相適護\ou伴\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: li-gol\e\3jen-der\e\3認
paragraphs: \e-人\wou\3-14\e\3年齡\te-ai-den-ti-ti\ha人\e\3登記\ha規定\kou-jen-der\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\e\3獨立申報\ou行\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

\e-人\wou\3sai-ko-lo-ji\e\3檢\kou行為\e\3e-va-liu-ei-shon\kou思想\e\3eks-zam\kou身\e\3構造\e\3檢\kou符合\e\3eks-zam\ou申報\e\3jen-der\e\3sou-shal\e\3期待\e\3充分符合\e\3判\hou要\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-国\wou\3jen-der\e\3記錄\e\3機密\e\3護\kou過去\e\3jen-der\e\3類\e\3披露\ha不需\e\3禁\ou行\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 4. mai-rij\e\3i-kual\kou家\e\3rait\ha-i-kual
paragraphs: \e-mai-rij\ha有\e\3人\sou\3財產\kou繼承\kou父母責\kou家\e\3di-si-zhon\kou離婚\kou-pab-lik\e\3服務\e\3rait\ha-i-kual\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
ri-li-jon\kou文化\e\3mai-rij\e\3規\ha配偶\e\3lou\e\3i-kual\kou身\e\3au-to-no-mi\kou遷徙\e\3fu-ri-dom\kou獨立\e\3di-si-zhon\e\3奪試\wou\3lou\e\3效力\ha有\pou\2\chi\4\wu\2\le\4。

subsections.heading: pab-lik\e\3設施
paragraphs: \e-pab-lik\e\3廁\kou更衣地\kou類似設施\wou\3\bi\ou全\e\3jen-der\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\e\3人\e\3容\hou設計\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-設施\e\3設計\wou\3pu-rai-va-si\ha人\e\3護\ha當\ou閉\e\3獨立空間\kou-seif-ti\e\3安排\kou-ak-se-si-bi-li-ti\e\3in-fu-ra-si-chak-cher\te供\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

\e-seif-ti\kou-pu-rai-va-si\e\3ri-ku-ai-er-man\wou\3全\e\3用人\te平等適用\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-此\e\3ri-ku-ai-er-man\wou\3二元\e\3jen-der\e\3分類\ha強制\ou依\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 體育\kou競技比賽
paragraphs: \e-ri-pab-lik\wou\3sai-ens\e\3e-va-liu-ei-shon\e\3生理\e\3si-tan-dad\e\3體育分類\e\3sis-tem\ha激素特征\e\3分組\e\3主基\ou行\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-體育分類\wou\3jen-der\e\3ai-den-ti-ti或出生指定\e\3jen-der\te自動決\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-體育\e\3au-so-ri-ti\wou\3項目\ha異\e\3激素分類\ou-chan-si-pa-ren-te\e\3sai-ens\e\3ri-ser-chi\kou定期ri-viu\e\3e-vi-dens\te定\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-休閒\kou-ko-miu-ni-ti\e\3體育\wou\3開放\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-此\e\3活動\wou\3jen-der\e\3排斥\ha無正當理由\ou行\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 6. jen-der\e\3dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\kou-jen-der\e\3仇恨\e\3禁
paragraphs: \e-dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\wou\3seks\kou-sek-shual-o-ri-en-tei-shon\kou-jen-der\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\kou-jen-der\e\3eks-pu-re-shon\kou性征\e\3基\e\3不平等待遇\ha-i-li-gol\kou排斥\kou-o-por-tiu-ni-ti\e\3奪\kou騷擾\kou-rait\e\3奪\ou含\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 表達\ha禁\e\3類
items: 直接\e\3jen-der\e\3威脅\kou對象\ha特定\e\3騷擾\kou故意羞辱
直接交流或pab-lik言論\te他人\e\3自申報\e\3jen-der\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\e\3故意否定
closing: \e-被禁\e\3言論\ha各\wou\3lou\e\3pe-nal-ti\ou受\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-jen-der\e\3等級關係\e\3公開宣揚\wou\3特定被害人未指\te亦lou\e\3pe-nal-ti\ou受\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

\e-lou\wou\3pe-nal-ti\ha強制\kou嚴重或反覆i-li-gol人\e\3刑罰\ha逐級加重\ou定\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-ri-ser-chi\ha-e-vi-dens\kou論理\e\3基\wou\3\bi\ou護\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。a-ka-de-mik\e\3名\ha僅\wou\3dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon宣傳\e\3責免\e\3因\pou\2\chi\4\wu\2\le\4。
\e-lou\e\3定義\wou\3故意dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\e\3鼓吹\kou騷擾\ha一方\kou正當討論\kou報道\kou-a-ka-de-mik\e\3考察\ha他方\ou分\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: a-ka-de-mik\e\3fu-ri-dom\e\3護
paragraphs: \e-a-ka-de-mik\e\3護\wou\3探\ha真\kou論理\kou-me-sod\e\3ho-nest\kou-e-vi-dens\e\3當用\e\3基\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。a-ka-de-mik\e\3護\wou\3官方結論\e\3同意\e\3因\pou\2\chi\4\wu\2\le\4。

subsections.heading: 7. 世俗\e\3ga-ver-nans\kou-ri-li-jon\e\3行\e\3監管
paragraphs: kon-si-ti-tiu-shon\sou\3ri-li-jon\e\3fu-ri-dom或ri-li-jon\e\3行\e\3fu-ri-dom\e\3護\ha獨立\pou\2\chi\4\wu\2\le\4。\e-一般\e\3ri-li-jon\e\3活動\wou\3世俗\e\3lou\e\3許\e\3域\ha僅\te有\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-jen-der\e\3i-kual違\e\3ri-li-jon\e\3行\wou\3\bi\ou參人\e\3自願\e\3言亦禁\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: ri-li-jon\e\3jen-der\e\3dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\e\3禁
paragraphs: \e-ri-li-jon\e\3基\e\3jen-der\e\3義務\kou從屬角色\wou\3\bi\ou全\e\3參人\e\3自願kon-sen-te亦禁\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。例\wou\3\e女\wou\3Muslim\e\3男\ou婚\hou\2\wou\3ri-li-jon\e\3義務\te頭巾\e\3戴或夫\e\3從\ou要求受\pou\2\chi\4。所謂自願\wou\3此\e\3行\e\3組織或行人\e\3lou\e\3責免\e\3因\pou\2\chi\4\wu\2\le\4。

\e-禁令\wou\3pu-rai-vet\e\3家\kou-ri-li-jon\e\3儀式\kou-dok-chin\e\3授\kou傳統安排\ou含\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。禁令\wou\3lou拘束\e\3契約\ha僅\pou\2\chi\4\wu\2\le\4。\e-ri-li-jon\e\3行\wou\3jen-der\e\3從屬義務或mai-rij\e\3位\ha不平等\ou建\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

\e-国\wou\3ri-li-jon\e\3in-si-ti-tiu-shon\kou-ri-li-jon\e\3首\kou-ri-li-jon\e\3行\kou參人\e\3相關行\e\3jen-der\e\3i-kual\e\3遵\e\3ri-viu\ha更嚴\kou主動\ou-dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\e\3固化或擴散\e\3發見\kou止\hou行\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

\e-ri-viu\e\3權\kou檢\kou調\wou\3\bi\ou-lou\te明規\kou-in-di-pen-den-te\e\3監\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。ri-li-jon\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\ha自身\wou\3ku-raim\pou\2\chi\4\wu\2\le\4。\e-責\e\3追\wou\3被禁行\ha具體\e\3e-vi-dens\ou要\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: ri-li-jon関連\e\3jen-der\e\3dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\e\3責\ha加重
paragraphs: \e-dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\ha-i-li-gol\kou認定\ha-ri-li-jon\e\3dok-chin\e\3動機或dok-chin\e\3正當化或dok-chin\e\3行\e\3際\sou\3ri-li-jon関連\e\3lou\e\3加重情節\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

ri-pab-lik\wou\3此\e\3區別\ou-dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\ha有\e\3ri-li-jon\e\3規\e\3ri-li-jon\e\3au-so-ri-ti\ha組織有\kou-in-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3傳承\kou-ko-miu-ni-ti間反覆宣揚\te-sou-shal\e\3im-pak-te追加\e\3憂\te採\pou\2\chi\4。

\e-kor-te\wou\3i-li-gol\e\3dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\kou-ri-li-jon\e\3動機或理由或行法\e\3已證\te同直接傷害\e\3非ri-li-jon\e\3dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\e\3案\e\3pe-nal-ti\ha更重\ou歧視\e\3追加擴散未證亦判\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

\e-jen-der\e\3dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\ha-ri-li-jon関連\kou已證\e\3案\ha全\wou\3強姦\e\3lou\e\3pe-nal-ti\e\3幅相當\e\3重刑\ha強制\ou適用\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。此\wou\3pe-nal-ti\e\3等\e\3對應。此\wou\3非性行為\e\3性犯罪\e\3虛假認定\pou\2\chi\4\wu\2\le\4。

\e-實施\e\3lou\wou\3ri-li-jon関連\e\3pe-nal-ti\e\3加重\ha強制\kou-i-li-gol行\e\3明定\kou-e-vi-dens\e\3si-tan-dad\kou-kor-te\ha-in-di-pen-den-te\e\3事實認定\ou規\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-加重\e\3pe-nal-ti\wou\3行為\e\3ri-li-jon関連\ha已證\e\3對象\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。加重\e\3pe-nal-ti\wou\3行人\e\3信仰\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\e\3對象\pou\2\chi\4\wu\2\le\4。
\e-此\e\3加重規\wou\3行為\kou動機\ha已證\te適用\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-此\e\3適用\wou\3行人\e\3ri-li-jon\e\3歸屬無關\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 8. 身\e\3au-to-no-mi\kou人\e\3侵害\e\3防
paragraphs: \e-me-di-kol\wou\3知情\kou自願\e\3kon-sen-te\ou一般要\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-kon-sen-te\ha有效\e\3得不可\e\3場合\wou\3護\ha嚴格限定\ou適用\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-人\wou\3me-di-kol\e\3pu-rou-si-jer或身\e\3改\tou\ou何人\ou-sou-shal或pou-li-ti-kol或ri-li-jon或jen-der\e\3期待\e\3符\ha僅\hou強迫\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-国\wou\3人\e\3身\e\3di-si-zhon\ou-au-so-ri-ti\e\3不常規或不可取\e\3認\ha僅\te干涉\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
护\e\3干預\ha他人\e\3i-li-gol\e\3傷\e\3防\e\3必需\wou\3許\e\a。\e-此\e\3di-si-zhon\wou\3立法\ha明\kou-in-di-pen-den-te\e\3監\e\3制限\ou受\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 性\e\3au-to-no-mi\kou-kon-sen-te
paragraphs: \e-性行為\ha-kon-sen-te無\kou身\e\3性\e\3au-to-no-mi\e\3侵害\ha全\wou\3強姦同級\e\3ku-raim\e\3類\ha統一\e\3納入\kou重刑\ou受\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-此\e\3規\wou\3當事人\e\3seks\kou-jen-der\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\kou-mai-rij\kou-ri-li-jon\e\3區別無\te適用\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-ku-raim\e\3要件\ha具體\kou-pu-rou-si-jer\ha正當\e\3護\wou\3\bi\ou刑法\te定\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-刑責\kou量刑\wou\3pu-rou-si-jer\ha正當\te立\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-犯罪\e\3定義\kou-pe-nal-ti\wou\3\bi\ou立法\te定\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 9. di-ji-tal\e\3pu-rai-va-si\kou-ser-vei-lans免\e\3fu-ri-dom
paragraphs: \e-人\wou\3pu-rai-vet\e\3通信\kou-ko-miu-ni-kei-shon\e\3記錄\kou人\e\3文件\kou瀏覽活動\kou他di-ji-tal\e\3in-for-mei-shon\ha敏感\ou-li-gol理由無\te訪\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: ku-raim\e\3調查\ha例外
paragraphs: \e-此\e\3ak-se-si-bi-li-ti\wou\3lou\e\3基\ha具體\kou-ju-di-shal\e\3授權\ha-in-di-pen-den-te\kou調查界\ha明\kou濫用\e\3防\e\3護\ha有效\ou要\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-人\sou\3自\e\3dei-ta\ha人\e\3閱\kou不準記錄\e\3改\kou未授權\e\3披露\e\3防\kou-lou\ha當許\te-dei-ta\e\3除\e\3rait\ha可行\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 外国人\e\3rait
paragraphs: \e-pou-li-ti-kol\e\3參\kou移民\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\kou他si-ti-zen\ha特定\e\3責\e\3區別\wou\3\bi\ou-lou\te-chan-si-pa-ren-te規\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-此\e\3區別\wou\3任意虐待或不當待遇\e\3理由\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 11. em-pu-loi-man\kou工\e\3o-por-tiu-ni-ti\e\3i-kual
paragraphs: \e-em-pu-loi-er\wou\3申請人或em-pu-loi-man人\ou-seks\kou-jen-der\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\kou-sek-shual-o-ri-en-tei-shon\kou-na-sho-na-li-ti\kou-es-ni-si-ti\kou-dis-a-bi-li-ti\kou家\e\3bak-gu-raun-de\kou他工無關特征\te-dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon行\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-em-pu-loi-er\e\3工\e\3o-por-tiu-ni-ti\e\3決\ha-dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\e\3si-tan-dad\kou任意人\e\3偏好\kou無關sou-shal\e\3特征\te-\wou\3\bi\ou禁\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-i-li-gol\e\3行\wou\3嚴重程度\te行政或民事或刑事\e\3pe-nal-ti\ha當\ou受\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

\e-ri-pab-lik\wou\3a-bi-li-ti\kou-me-rit\e\3工\e\3選\e\3pu-rin-si-pol\ou認\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-ri-pab-lik\wou\3\e-si-chak-cher\e\3不利處境\wou\3人\e\3a-bi-li-ti\ha實\e\3展示\ou不阻\hou\2\ou確保\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 12. ak-se-si-bi-li-ti\kou-i-kual\e\3參
paragraphs: \e-国\wou\3dis-a-bi-li-ti\e\3人\kou-ak-se-si-bi-li-ti\e\3追加需\e\3人\e\3pab-lik生活\e\3實參\ou確保\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-ak-se-si-bi-li-ti\wou\3sen-zou-vi-a\e\3ga-van-man\e\3常規責任\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。ak-se-si-bi-li-ti\wou\3慈善服務\ha可有可無\pou\2\chi\4\wu\2\le\4。

\e-pab-lik\e\3建築\kou交通\e\3sis-tem\kou-yu-du-kei-shon\e\3in-si-ti-tiu-shon\kou-di-ji-tal\e\3sen-zou-vi-a\e\3ga-van-man\e\3平台\kou休閒設施\kou他pab-lik\e\3se-paot\e\3in-fu-ra-si-chak-cher\wou\3包容設計\e\3pu-rin-si-pol\ou含\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-国\e\3bad-jet\wou\3ak-se-si-bi-li-ti\e\3in-fu-ra-si-chak-cher\kou輔助\e\3tek-no-lo-ji\kou合理便利\kou-se-paot\e\3服務\ha基\e\3專項ri-sor-sis\ou供\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-ak-se-si-bi-li-ti\e\3pou-le-cei\wou\3人\e\3需\ha異\kou同待遇非恒真i-kual\e\3o-por-tiu-ni-ti\e\3供\e\3事\ou認\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 13. sou-shal\e\3流動\kou-o-por-tiu-ni-ti\e\3展
paragraphs: \e-sen-zou-vi-a\wou\3sou-shal\ha人\wou\3自\e\3a-bi-li-ti\kou志\ou展\e\a\pou\ou繼承財富\kou-sou-shal\e\3bak-gu-raun-de\kou家\e\3關係\kou出生處境\e\3決定制約無\te求\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: sai-ens\kou-tek-no-lo-ji\e\3i-no-vei-shon
paragraphs: \e-ri-pab-lik\wou\3i-no-vei-shon\ha新em-pu-loi-man\e\3域\e\3造\kou-pab-lik\e\3有用tek-no-lo-ji\e\3o-por-tiu-ni-ti\e\3展\kou可避免參障礙\e\3減\ou勵\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-国\wou\3人\e\3新o-por-tiu-ni-ti\e\3得\e\3si-chak-cher\e\3不平等\e\3監\kou-li-gol措施\e\3解\e\3定\ou行\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

o-por-tiu-ni-ti\ha-i-kual\wou\3各\e\3人\e\3同ri-zal-te\e\3要\pou\2\chi\4\wu\2\le\4。\e-o-por-tiu-ni-ti\ha-i-kual\wou\3人\e\3o-por-tiu-ni-ti追求\e\3不公阻\kou無關人特征\e\3判\e\3無\ou要\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 14. 民\e\3主權\kou-pab-lik\e\3sen-zou-vi-a\e\3ga-van-man\e\3制
paragraphs: \e-si-ti-zen\sou\3in-for-mei-shon\ha-pab-lik\e\3申\kou-sen-zou-vi-a\e\3ga-van-man\e\3支出\e\3審\kou行政\e\3di-si-zhon\e\3質疑\kou-au-so-ri-ti\ha-pab-lik\e\3請願\kou民主監\e\3參\e\3rait\ha可行\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-国\wou\3chan-si-pa-ren-te\e\3di-si-zhon\kou支出\e\3pu-rou-si-jer\ou維\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。lou\e\3必需\e\3保密護\ha嚴格限\wou\3例外\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-民\e\3主權\wou\3pou-li-ti-kol\e\3多數\e\3少數群體或人\e\3rait\ha-kon-si-ti-tiu-shon\kou基\e\3奪\ou授權\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 15. rait\ha人\e\3委員會\ha-in-di-pen-den-te
paragraphs: \e-委員會\wou\3行政指揮無\te獨立行\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-委員會\sou\3lou\e\3護\e\3in-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3au-to-no-mi\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
closing: \e-委員會\wou\3in-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3記錄\ha相關\e\3取\kou侵權\ha嚴重\e\3ju-di-shal\e\3機關\ha管轄有\e\3移交\ou-pu-rou-si-jer\ha-li-gol\te行\e\a\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-其\e\3in-di-pen-den-te\wou\3\bi\ou任命\ha-chan-si-pa-ren-te\kou-fan-ding\ha穩\kou委員\e\3任意罷免\e\3防\e\3護\te護\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-国\wou\3rait\ha人\e\3护\ha依法求\e\3人\e\3恐嚇\kou阻\kou罰\ou禁\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 16. ju-di-shal\ha-i-kual\kou-kon-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3rait\e\3行
paragraphs: \e-ri-pab-lik\wou\3pu-rou-si-jer\ha正當\kou裁判\ha-in-di-pen-den-te\kou無罪推定\kou指控及sen-zou-vi-a\e\3ga-van-man\e\3di-si-zhon\e\3適當lou\e\3pu-rou-si-jer\e\3異議\e\3rait\ou護\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-人\wou\3他人\e\3刑責\ou-ri-li-jon或ai-den-ti-ti或sou-shal\e\3bak-gu-raun-de或特定ko-miu-ni-ti\e\3關係\ha僅\te推定\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
ju-di-shal\e\3re-me-di\wou\3命令\ha可行\kou賠償\kou护\e\3措施\kou-in-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3改正\kou適用時\e\3刑罰\ou含\e\a\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-in-si-ti-tiu-shon\wou\3kon-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3護\e\3規避\bi\ou内部規章或私約或in-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3特權\e\3主張\te許\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

closing: sen-zou-vi-a\e\3ga-van-man\wou\3fu-ri-dom\kou-o-por-tiu-ni-ti\ha-i-kual\e\3非群體\ha特定\e\3特權\kou人\e\3dig-ni-ti\e\3基條件\e\3事\ou認。\e-ri-pab-lik\wou\3各\e\3人\e\3ai-den-ti-ti\e\3決\kou-rait\e\3行\kou-a-bi-li-ti\e\3展\kou-sou-shal\e\3參\e\3a-bi-li-ti\ou護\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-ri-pab-lik\wou\3dis-ku-ri-mi-nei-shon\kou-kou-er-shon\kou-pou-wer濫用\e\3防\e\3保障\ha可行\ou維\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
